a2-191.title: Communicative Challenge: Who Is Coming?
a2-191.scenario: Lili and Bálint are packing for the trip to the Balaton. You are Bálint. Lili asks who is coming along and whether your keys are in your bag.
a2-191.prompt: Answer Lili: tell her that your friends and your parents are coming, and that your keys are in your bag.
a2-191.target: A barátaim és a szüleim jönnek. A kulcsaim a táskámban vannak.
a2-191.english: My friends and my parents are coming. My keys are in my bag.
a2-191.canDo: I can use plural possessed nouns for my own things, such as barátaim, könyveim and kulcsaim (-aim, -eim).

a2-192.title: Communicative Challenge: Where Are Your Things?
a2-192.scenario: Bálint and Lili are waiting at the station when Máté arrives without his bags. You are Bálint and you speak to Máté.
a2-192.prompt: Ask Máté where his things are, and tell him that Lili's parents are already here.
cues: Say that Lili's parents are already here
a2-192.target: Hol vannak a dolgaid? Lili szülei már itt vannak.
a2-192.english: Where are your things? Lili's parents are already here.
a2-192.canDo: I can say your friends (barátaid) and his/her friends (barátai) with -aid/-eid and -ai/-ei.

a2-193.title: Communicative Challenge: Our Plans for the Balaton
a2-193.scenario: Máté phones Lili and Bálint to ask who is coming to the Balaton and what the plans are. You are Lili and you answer for you and Bálint.
a2-193.prompt: Tell Máté that your friends and your parents are coming too, and that your plans are very exciting.
cues: Say what you think of your plans
a2-193.target: A barátaink és a szüleink is jönnek. A terveink nagyon izgalmasak.
a2-193.english: Our friends and our parents are coming too. Our plans are very exciting.
a2-193.canDo: I can form and use plural possessed forms for plural owners (-aink/-eink, -aitok/-eitek, -aik/-eik).

a2-194.title: Communicative Challenge: A Present for My Parents
a2-194.scenario: Máté meets Bálint at the station and asks about the weekend. You are Bálint.
a2-194.prompt: Tell Máté who you are travelling to the Balaton with, and that you bought a present for your parents.
cues: Say who you are travelling with
Say who the present is for
a2-194.target: A barátaimmal utazom a Balatonra. A szüleimnek ajándékot vettem.
a2-194.english: I am travelling to the Balaton with my friends. I bought a present for my parents.
a2-194.canDo: I can attach instrumental (-val/-vel), dative (-nak/-nek), and spatial cases to plural possessed nouns.

a2-195.title: Communicative Challenge: Whose Suitcase?
a2-195.scenario: At the door of the flat, Lili asks Máté (you) whether the tickets and documents are with him, and whose suitcase is standing by the door.
a2-195.prompt: Answer Lili: tell her that your tickets and documents are in your pocket, and that the suitcase is not yours but Bálint's.
cues: Say where your tickets and documents are
a2-195.target: A jegyeim és az irataim a zsebemben vannak. A bőrönd nem az enyém, hanem Bálinté.
a2-195.english: My tickets and my documents are in my pocket. The suitcase is not mine, it is Bálint's.
a2-195.canDo: I can use plural possessed nouns of all persons with the accusative and other endings.

a2-195-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Ready to Go
a2-195-consolidation.scenario: Before leaving the flat, Lili asks Bálint (you) who he is travelling with and where he put his keys.
a2-195-consolidation.prompt: Answer Lili: say that you are travelling with your friends and your parents, and that you put your keys into your bag.
cues: Say who you are travelling with
Say where you put your keys
a2-195-consolidation.target: A barátaimmal és a szüleimmel utazom. A kulcsaimat a táskámba tettem.
a2-195-consolidation.english: I am travelling with my friends and my parents. I put my keys into my bag.
a2-195-consolidation.canDo: I can use plural possessed nouns for all persons, with the endings of this unit (-aim, -eid, -ai, -eink, -eitek, -eik).
